project_type: Python FastAPI backend - Autonomous AI Company Operating System
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), mock-based DB sessions in conftest.py
verification_instructions: Run pytest and confirm all tests pass (currently 2276). No external dependencies required for tests.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Docker required for tests. Tests use mock DB sessions. SQLite used for local dev.
contribution_requirements: Python 3.12, type hints, docstrings, ruff formatting (100 char lines), no new external dependencies for Phase 1 tasks (stdlib only for new modules), persistence is opt-in and backward compatible
key_patterns: 1) Modules use dataclasses/Pydantic for config. 2) Tests use plain classes (TestXxx) with pytest fixtures. 3) FastAPI routers in src/nexus/api/routes/. 4) Config via pydantic-settings in src/nexus/config.py. 5) Atomic file writes for persistence (temp + os.replace pattern). 6) No external deps for new functionality.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ - main package with subsystem dirs (governance/, orchestration/, memory/, api/, etc.). tests/ - flat test files. docs/ - documentation. dashboard/ - frontend (DO NOT TOUCH).
